notes.title: Content Update!
notes.content:
[b]New stuff:[/b]
[list]
[*] Turrets that attack the player!
[*] 3 new equipment items, the scissorang, packapeanut, and box cutter!
[*] New sound effect when picking up money!
[*] Boss intro cards!
[/list]
[b]Fixes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Music not playing inside the fishing areas.
[*] Melee attacks not registering properly.
[*] Enemy pathing being buggy when you hugged the top wall.
[/list]
[b]Changes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Less boxes in levels. The player was getting too many items.
[*] In the Quincy fight, the laser used to kill you, now it should just push you away.
[*] Characters are cheaper to unlock.
[/list]
[i]There are probably some more things that I forgot to mention.[/i]

notes.title: Small update
notes.content:
[b]New stuff![/b]
[list]
[*]Large Pencil: Throw a large pencil that burrows through most enemies and walls! you just have to pick it up afterwords...
[/list]
[b]Changes![/b]
[list]
[*] Changed Spicy Coffee to not hinder movement if you are hugging a wall, this also makes it so you can actually move while hugging a wall.
[*] Added some GAMEOVER text after you die, and you will be booted back to the main menu after 3 seconds.
[/list]
[b]Upcoming![/b]
I have a content update [i]hopefully [/i]coming soon that will introduce some more things into Tax Evasion!
[list]
[*] New Items!
[*] New Enemies!
[*] New Rooms!
[/list]

notes.title: Some tweaks.
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Doors are easier to enter when you have higher movement speed.
[*] Donuts from "Not Your Sandwich" Are more visible.
[*] Thumbtack damage scales with the players damage.
[*] Tony no longer goes through walls.
[*] Audio settings are less touchy.
[/list]
